# SAP SuccessFactors

Cloud-based human capital management software covering Employee Central, Recruiting, Performance & Goals, Learning, Compensation, and more.

Category: Recruiting & HR. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/sap-successfactors/.

## Actions

- **Get Current User** (read-only): Retrieves the currently authenticated user's information from SAP SuccessFactors.
